SELECT 
    ek.slchd_establishment_key,
    COALESCE(e.name, ek.name) as name,
    COUNT(i.inspection_id) as total_inspections,
    MIN(i.inspection_date) as earliest_date,
    MAX(i.inspection_date) as latest_date
FROM establishment_keys ek
JOIN inspections i ON ek.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
LEFT JOIN establishments e ON ek.slchd_establishment_key = e.slchd_establishment_key
WHERE i.inspection_date >= '2021-07-17'
GROUP BY ek.slchd_establishment_key, COALESCE(e.name, ek.name)
HAVING COUNT(i.inspection_id) >= 2
ORDER BY total_inspections DESC
LIMIT 20;

WITH insp_crit AS (
    SELECT 
        i.inspection_id,
        i.slchd_establishment_key,
        i.inspection_date,
        YEAR(i.inspection_date) as insp_year,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 END) as critical_count
    FROM inspections i
    LEFT JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
    LEFT JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
    WHERE i.inspection_date >= '2021-01-01'
    GROUP BY i.inspection_id, i.slchd_establishment_key, i.inspection_date
),
period_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        slchd_establishment_key,
        -- Early period: 2021 - 2023
        COUNT(CASE WHEN insp_year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023 THEN 1 END) as early_inspections,
        SUM(CASE WHEN insp_year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023 THEN critical_count ELSE 0 END) as early_criticals,
        AVG(CASE WHEN insp_year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023 THEN critical_count END) as early_avg_crit,
        -- Late period: 2024 - 2026
        COUNT(CASE WHEN insp_year BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 THEN 1 END) as late_inspections,
        SUM(CASE WHEN insp_year BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 THEN critical_count ELSE 0 END) as late_criticals,
        AVG(CASE WHEN insp_year BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 THEN critical_count END) as late_avg_crit
    FROM insp_crit
    GROUP BY slchd_establishment_key
)
SELECT 
    ek.name,
    ps.slchd_establishment_key,
    ps.early_inspections,
    ps.early_criticals,
    ROUND(ps.early_avg_crit, 2) as early_avg_crit,
    ps.late_inspections,
    ps.late_criticals,
    ROUND(ps.late_avg_crit, 2) as late_avg_crit,
    ROUND(ps.late_avg_crit - ps.early_avg_crit, 2) as avg_crit_change
FROM period_stats ps
JOIN establishment_keys ek ON ps.slchd_establishment_key = ek.slchd_establishment_key
WHERE ps.early_inspections > 0 AND ps.late_inspections > 0
ORDER BY avg_crit_change DESC
LIMIT 15;

WITH insp_crit AS (
    SELECT 
        i.inspection_id,
        i.slchd_establishment_key,
        i.inspection_date,

        COUNT(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 END) as critical_count
    FROM inspections i

    LEFT JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
    WHERE i.inspection_date >= '2021-01-01'
    GROUP BY i.inspection_id, i.slchd_establishment_key, i.inspection_date
),
period_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        slchd_establishment_key,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN insp_year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023 THEN 1 END) as early_inspections,
        AVG(CASE WHEN insp_year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023 THEN critical_count END) as early_avg_crit,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN insp_year BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 THEN 1 END) as late_inspections,
        AVG(CASE WHEN insp_year BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 THEN critical_count END) as late_avg_crit
    FROM insp_crit
    GROUP BY slchd_establishment_key
),
changes AS (
    SELECT 
        slchd_establishment_key,
        early_avg_crit,
        late_avg_crit,
        late_avg_crit - early_avg_crit as diff,
        CASE 
            WHEN late_avg_crit - early_avg_crit > 0 THEN 'Increased'
            WHEN late_avg_crit - early_avg_crit < 0 THEN 'Decreased'

)

    COUNT(*) as establishment_count,

FROM changes
